August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 153)

This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on August 26 across American and international networks, Martin Blaine starring as Special Agent Sheppard in three FBI in Peace and War federal cases (Lava Soap highway hijacking, Wildroot Ten Most Wanted pursuit, and Wrigley's Spearmint blackmail ring), Dinah Shore and soprano saxophone pioneer Sidney Bechet on Milton Cross' Chamber Music Society of Lower Basin Street for Jell-O, U.S. Army Airborne Infantry paratroopers on Voice of the Army, and Michael Mayer's Jim the Great (1940–1979):
